text: `docker compose up -d --build` starts all services cleanly with no errors.
The agno-app service is reachable at http://localhost:8000 and `/docs` returns HTTP 200.
n8n is in compose.yaml and accessible at http://localhost:5678 after boot.
Cloudflare R2 is mounted into agno-app at `/r2` via rclone volume.
The agno-app container does NOT use `--reload`.
`app/main.py` uses `AgentOS(base_app=fastapi_app)` + `get_app()` — no subpath mount.
All API requests enter through `agents["router"]` (mode="route"); routing is correct per family.
SQL migrations apply on first boot; all tables exist with `uuidv7()` PKs.
A `default_transaction_read_only=on` connection rejects writes to the `evidence` schema.
Paused native-confirm runs produce `approval_request` rows with non-null `run_id`.
`agents/providers.py` builds a `PlatformContext` with all expected tool lists.
DatabaseContextProvider read sub-agent cannot invoke write tools.
LearningMachine wired with PROPOSE mode; proposed learnings require human confirm.
Embeddings work without a separate OpenAI key, or `example.env` clearly documents the requirement.
`knowledge/platform/conversations/` exists as the drop zone for hand-selected transcripts (feeds Knowledge base, NOT evidence DB).
`scripts/ingest_knowledge.py` calls `knowledge.ainsert()` — not a stub.
`python -m agents.ingestion` completes without import errors and reports doc count.
Dev Copilot answers an architecture question citing content from ingested transcripts.
Platform boots with NVIDIA NIM key; also works with Ollama Cloud/local key.
`example.env` documents all boot variables including embeddings key requirement.
